Dear Dr. Greg Jefferis

Sorry for bothering you again.
Recently, I updated the R environment and RStudio, but found it is incompatible to the Natverse packages. Then I reinstall R V4.2.1 and all the nat packages. 
However, the new problem happens. Now, I cannot access to the FlyCircuit data again. The error below always occurs. Do you have any clue?
Looking forward to hearing from you soon.

Best 
Xiyang

Dear Xiyang,

The error message is not very helpful, but I am afraid the problem is quite simple. The flycircuit database is down:


you will need to contact them to see if there is any timeline for putting it back up. 

In the meantime you can get the data from neuromorpho but I am not sure about what space the SWC files are in

https://neuromorpho.org/MetaDataResult.jsp?count=23635&summary={%22neuron%22:{%22species%22:[%22drosophila%20melanogaster%22],%22archive%22:[%22Chiang%22]},%22ageWeightOperators%22:{},%22ageWeightOperations%22:{}}

Best wishes,

Greg.
